rawRecord.short_description: Provides secure access to SignNow eSignature workflows including templates, signing invitations, and document management.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with SignNow's eSignature platform to enable document workflow automation. Supports template browsing, document creation from templates, email and embedded signing invitations, field prefilling, document group handling, status tracking, and direct download links. Offers both STDIO and Streamable HTTP transport options with OAuth 2.0 or username/password authentication.
